title: A Major Ruling From Facebook’s ‘Supreme Court’

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简报栏目 Dealbook 的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11 月 18 日，我将在纽约市 Dealbook 峰会的现场，采访商界、政界和文化界的一些核心领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zoran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、佐兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11 月 18 日，我们将在 nytimes.com 上直播精选采访，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并免费获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能收听。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: In the biggest ruling since its creation, Facebook's oversight board found that the company had no basis for indefinitely banning Donald Trump from the platform.
sentences.zh: 在 Facebook 创立以来最大的一起裁决中，该公司的监督委员会裁定，该公司无限期禁止唐纳德·特朗普使用该平台的做法没有根据。

sentences.en: I spoke with my colleague, technology reporter Cecilia Kang, about what that tells us about Facebook's Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 我采访了我的同事、科技记者塞西莉亚·康，讨论这向我们透露了关于 Facebook“最高法院”的什么信息。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, May 6th.
sentences.zh: 今天是 5 月 6 日，星期四。

sentences.en: Cecilia, tell me about this oversight board that Facebook created and what it's designed to do.
sentences.zh: 塞西莉亚，跟我讲讲 Facebook 创建的这个监督委员会，以及它的设计初衷是什么。

sentences.en: The Facebook oversight board was created about a year ago, and it was an idea that Facebook's CEO, Mark Zuckerberg, had been kicking around for much longer.
sentences.zh: Facebook 监督委员会是在大约一年前成立的，这是 Facebook 首席执行官马克·扎克伯格酝酿了很长时间的一个想法。

sentences.en: My goal here is to create a governance structure around the content in the community that reflects more what people in the community want.
sentences.zh: 我在这里的目标是围绕社区中的内容建立一个治理结构，更多地反映社区人们的意愿。

sentences.en: He talked about it in 2018 on the Vox podcast, The Ezra Klein Show.
sentences.zh: 他在 2018 年的 Vox 播客节目《以斯拉·克莱因秀》中谈到了这一点。

sentences.en: You can imagine even some sort of structure, almost like a Supreme Court or appeals board that is made up of independent
sentences.zh: 你可以想象甚至某种结构，几乎就像一个最高法院或上诉委员会，由独立的

sentences.en: folks who don't work for Facebook, who ultimately get to make the final judgment call on what should be acceptable speech in a community.
sentences.zh: 不为 Facebook 工作的人组成，他们最终对社区中什么应该是可接受的言论做出最终裁决。

sentences.en: And he described it as sort of a Supreme Court that would be an adjudicating body that makes decisions on the hardest and the thorniest and the most controversial
sentences.zh: 他将其描述为某种类似于最高法院的裁决机构，负责对最艰难、最棘手、最具争议的

sentences.en: speech decisions that Facebook made.
sentences.zh: Facebook 做出的言论决策做出裁决。

sentences.en: And if we do that well, then I think that that could really break ground on governance for this kind of an internet community.
sentences.zh: 如果我们能做好这一点，那么我认为这确实可以开创此类互联网社区治理的先河。

sentences.en: And when you say speech decisions, you mean just the gnarliest, most contentious posts that get on Facebook and that people say
sentences.zh: 当你谈到言论决策时，你的意思是那些进入 Facebook 的、最糟糕、最具争议的帖子，人们说

sentences.en: shouldn't be there or that their posters shouldn't be allowed to poSt.
sentences.zh: 不应该出现在那里，或者发帖者不应该被允许发帖。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And they make hundreds of these tough decisions every day with 3 billion users.
sentences.zh: 在拥有 30 亿用户的情况下，他们每天都要做出数百个这样的艰难决定。

sentences.en: These are decisions about political figures.
sentences.zh: 这些是关于政治人物的决定。

sentences.en: These are decisions about neo-Nazis that take place every day on the website.
sentences.zh: 这些是关于每天在网站上发生的新纳粹分子的决定。

sentences.en: And the sheer volume that Facebook confronts of this kind of content is for the company overwhelming.
sentences.zh: Facebook 面对的此类内容的庞大数量对公司来说是压倒性的。

sentences.en: And Zuckerberg has said that it's too much for one company and any set of individuals within a company, and himself even, to have to be the arbiter of these kinds of decisions.
sentences.zh: 扎克伯格曾表示，这对一家公司、公司内的任何个人甚至他自己来说都太多了，不应该成为此类决策的仲裁者。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So this board is going to relieve the company, in theory, of this obligation to sort out the most difficult questions that it faces about what can be on its platform.
sentences.zh: 所以理论上，这个委员会将把公司从这种义务中解放出来，即去理清它面临的关于什么可以出现在其平台上的最困难的问题。

sentences.en: That's the idea.
sentences.zh: 这就是想法所在。

sentences.en: The idea is that a user and Facebook itself can appeal decisions or refer decisions that are much too controversial or just too hard.
sentences.zh: 这个想法是，用户和 Facebook 本身可以对过于具有争议或太难的决定进行上诉或移交决定。

sentences.en: So a user, for example, who may have had a post taken down or their account suspended can go to this oversight board and appeal the right to get their content reinstated.
sentences.zh: 例如，一个帖子被删除或账户被暂停的用户可以向这个监督委员会上诉，以恢复其内容的权利。

sentences.en: So the idea is for Facebook to lessen its grip over the power it has on speech over its platform.
sentences.zh: 所以这个想法是为了让 Facebook 放松其对其平台言论权力的掌控。

sentences.en: And so what kind of person ends up being appointed to this panel, the Supreme Court of Facebook, which I must say sounds like a pretty prestigious job.
sentences.zh: 那么，什么样的人最终会被任命为这个小组（即 Facebook 的“最高法院”）的成员呢？我必须说，这听起来像是一个相当崇高的职位。

sentences.en: So far, there have been 20 members appointed to the Facebook oversight board.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，已有 20 名成员被任命加入 Facebook 监督委员会。

sentences.en: And the 20 members are journalists, former politicians, including the former prime minister of Denmark, and human rights activists.
sentences.zh: 这 20 名成员包括记者、前政客（包括丹麦前首相）以及人权活动家。

sentences.en: They are international.
sentences.zh: 他们是国际化的。

sentences.en: They represent several countries.
sentences.zh: 他们代表了几个国家。

sentences.en: And it should be noted that
sentences.zh: 并且应该指出的是

sentences.en: Facebook constructed this board, and they helped choose the first members.
sentences.zh: Facebook 组建了这个委员会，他们帮助挑选了第一批成员。

sentences.en: And they had a say in the other following members who were chosen.
sentences.zh: 并且他们在挑选其他后续成员时拥有发言权。

sentences.en: They fund the board with a $130 million truSt.
sentences.zh: 他们用一个 1.3 亿美元的信托基金资助这个委员会。

sentences.en: The whole idea is to have this outside body, this third party court, if you will, be at arm's length from Facebook.
sentences.zh: 整个想法是让这个外部机构（如果你愿意的话，可以称之为第三方法院）与 Facebook 保持距离。

sentences.en: So that description would seem to immediately raise questions about just how independent this oversight board really is.
sentences.zh: 所以这种描述似乎会立即引发关于这个监督委员会究竟有多独立的疑问。

sentences.en: So how does the board talk about that?
sentences.zh: 那么委员会是如何谈论这一点的呢？

sentences.en: How does Facebook talk about that?
sentences.zh: Facebook 是如何谈论这一点的呢？

sentences.en: Yeah, the independence of the board has really haunted the company since its establishment a year ago.
sentences.zh: 是的，自一年前成立以来，委员会的独立性一直困扰着该公司。

sentences.en: And they point to a few things.
sentences.zh: 他们指出了几点。

sentences.en: They say, number one, that once the board takes a case, there is zero communication between board members and the company.
sentences.zh: 他们说，第一，一旦委员会接手一个案件，委员会成员与公司之间就零沟通。

sentences.en: So there's a wall that's erected essentially.
sentences.zh: 所以本质上是建立了一堵墙。

sentences.en: Gotcha.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: Number two, they say that all decisions are binding.
sentences.zh: 第二，他们说所有决定都是具有约束力的。

sentences.en: And what that means is that once the board decides on a case, that Facebook must implement its decision.
sentences.zh: 这意味着一旦委员会对案件做出裁决，Facebook 就必须实施其决定。

sentences.en: And the third board is they say that there is a trust that was established, a trust that pays the board members and
sentences.zh: 第三个保证是他们说成立了一个信托基金，一个支付委员会成员薪酬的信托基金，

sentences.en: that pays for the operations of the board and all of its employees.
sentences.zh: 并且支付委员会及其所有员工的运营费用。

sentences.en: And the reason why they point to that is they say that there is no financial commingling between the company and the board, that there is an
sentences.zh: 他们指出这一点的原因是，他们说公司和委员会之间没有财务上的交织，有一个

sentences.en: outside body that administers all the money that's paid to the employees of the board.
sentences.zh: 外部机构管理支付给委员会员工的所有资金。

sentences.en: So in other words,
sentences.zh: 换句话说，

sentences.en: Mark Zuckerberg can't technically write the checks for the board members and that there is not
sentences.zh: 马克·扎克伯格在技术上不能为委员会成员开支票，并且

sentences.en: influence potentially financially because the board is being paid by a third body, not Facebook.
sentences.zh: 由于委员会是由第三方机构而不是 Facebook 支付薪酬的，因此潜在的财务影响力是不存在的。

sentences.en: And once this quasi-independent board is set up, what kinds of rulings has it issued so far?
sentences.zh: 一旦这个准独立的委员会建立起来，到目前为止它发布了什么样的裁决？

sentences.en: Well, it's only issued a handful of rulings so far.
sentences.zh: 嗯，到目前为止它只发布了少数几个裁决。

sentences.en: The first came out starting in January.
sentences.zh: 第一个从 1 月份开始出台。

sentences.en: They all have to do with posts that Facebook took down because the post violated the company's own rules on speech.
sentences.zh: 这些都与 Facebook 删除的帖子有关，因为这些帖子违反了公司自身的言论规则。

sentences.en: And they ran the gamut really from an Instagram post in Brazil that showed a photo of breast nipples.
sentences.zh: 它们确实范围广泛，从巴西的一条展示乳头照片的 Instagram 帖子开始。

sentences.en: And in that case, the board decided that Facebook was wrong to take down that post because the photo was meant to promote breast cancer awareness.
sentences.zh: 在那起案件中，委员会裁定 Facebook 删除该帖子的做法是错误的，因为该照片旨在促进乳腺癌意识。

sentences.en: In another case, a user quoted a
sentences.zh: 在另一个案件中，一名用户引用了一名

sentences.en: Nazi propagandist and Facebook took down that post saying that the post and the quote violated the company's rules against hate speech.
sentences.zh: 纳粹宣传人员的话，Facebook 删除了该帖子，称该帖子和引言违反了公司关于仇恨言论的规则。

sentences.en: But the Facebook oversight board overturned that decision and said that the user, in fact, had intended to use that quote, that Nazi propaganda quote, to compare Trump's
sentences.zh: 但 Facebook 监督委员会推翻了这一决定，并表示该用户实际上打算使用该引言（即那句纳粹宣传引言）来将特朗普

sentences.en: own comments and speech to Nazi propaganda.
sentences.zh: 自己的评论和言论与纳粹宣传进行比较。

sentences.en: And they said that it was not in violation, nor was it intended to be in violation of the company's hate speech rules.
sentences.zh: 他们表示，这并未违反公司的仇恨言论规则，也没有意图违反。

sentences.en: So in the vast majority of the decisions, the board has really erred more on the side of free expression and has overruled the company's initial decisions.
sentences.zh: 因此，在绝大多数决定中，委员会实际上更多地倾向于言论自由一边，并推翻了公司最初的决定。

sentences.en: And in fact, that has been in some ways the best proof of its independence.
sentences.zh: 事实上，在某种程度上，这已经是其独立性的最好证明。

sentences.en: So the way the board has proven its independence from Facebook is by directly contravening Facebook's
sentences.zh: 所以委员会向 Facebook 证明其独立性的方式，就是几乎在所有这些要求删除帖子的案件中，直接违背了 Facebook

sentences.en: original decision in almost all these cases to take down a poSt. Yeah, that's right.
sentences.zh: 最初的决定。是的，没错。

sentences.en: Though we should keep in mind that there really have only been a handful of decisions made so far by the Facebook oversight board.
sentences.zh: 虽然我们应该记住，到目前为止 Facebook 监督委员会只做出了少数几个决定。

sentences.en: And those decisions are really small compared to the big case that the oversight board agreed to take on four months ago, which was the indefinite ban of President Trump.
sentences.zh: 与监督委员会四个月前同意受理的大案（即对特朗普总统的无限期禁令）相比，这些决定真的很小。

sentences.en: And so what was the decision before the board on this case, Trump versus Facebook?
sentences.zh: 那么在针对这个案件（特朗普诉 Facebook 案）时，委员会面临的决定是什么？

sentences.en: So the decision before the board was whether Facebook was justified in his decision on January 7th to indefinitely ban Trump from Facebook and Instagram.
sentences.zh: 所以委员会面临的决定是，Facebook 在 1 月 7 日做出无限期禁止特朗普使用 Facebook 和 Instagram 的决定是否正当。

sentences.en: And we have to remember that on Facebook, Trump had
sentences.zh: 我们必须记住，在 Facebook 上，特朗普拥有

sentences.en: 35 million followers.
And on Instagram, he had 24 million.
sentences.zh: 在 Instagram 上，他拥有 2400 万。

sentences.en: And on January 6th, on Facebook and
sentences.zh: 而在 1 月 6 日，在 Facebook 和

sentences.en: Instagram, Trump said that the Capitol rioters were great patriots and that the election was stolen from us.
sentences.zh: Instagram 上，特朗普表示国会大厦骚乱者是伟大的爱国者，大选是从我们手中偷走的。

sentences.en: Facebook said that his comments inside of violence and violated their own internal rules on speech.
sentences.zh: Facebook 表示，他的言论煽动了暴力，并违反了他们自己内部的言论规则。

sentences.en: And what the board was wrestling with was whether that decision was justified.
sentences.zh: 委员会正在纠结的是，这一决定是否正当。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So it doesn't get much bigger than this.
sentences.zh: 所以没有比这更大的事情了。

sentences.en: The board is being asked to rule whether a former commander-in-chief of the United States, the president of the country, can be permanently
sentences.zh: 委员会被要求裁决美国前三军统帅、国家总统是否可以被永久

sentences.en: barred from ever posting anything on any Facebook site.
sentences.zh: 禁止在任何 Facebook 网站上发布任何内容。

sentences.en: It was defining and the biggest decision that Facebook had before it.
sentences.zh: 这是决定性的，也是 Facebook 面前最大的决定。

sentences.en: And it is incredibly important because Trump is banned permanently from Twitter and YouTube has indefinitely banned
sentences.zh: 而且这非常重要，因为特朗普被永久禁止使用推特，而 YouTube 也无限期禁止了

sentences.en: Trump, but has not said when they will allow him back on.
sentences.zh: 特朗普，但没有说明何时允许他重返。

sentences.en: So the decision by the Facebook
sentences.zh: 因此，Facebook

sentences.en: Oversight Board presented the first opportunity for Trump to regain one of those megaphones.
sentences.zh: 监督委员会的决定为特朗普重新获得其中一个扩音器提供了第一个机会。

sentences.en: And for the board, it is their Super Bowl of decisions, a board that's just a few months in effect.
sentences.zh: 对于委员会来说，这是他们决策中的“超级碗”，一个成立仅几个月的委员会。

sentences.en: And this is the big one.
sentences.zh: 而这就是那个大事件。

sentences.en: And so how does the board go about making this kind of a decision?
sentences.zh: 那么委员会是如何着手做出这种决定的呢？

sentences.en: The board deliberated this particular case just like it does every other case before it.
sentences.zh: 委员会审议这个特定案件的方式就像审议其面前的其他所有案件一样。

sentences.en: It chose five members to look specifically at the Trump case and they looked at the particulars
sentences.zh: 它挑选了五名成员专门研究特朗普案件，他们研究了特朗普在帖子中所说内容

sentences.en: of what Trump said in his post and if Facebook was justified in taking those posts down as well as banning the president's account at the time.
sentences.zh: 的细节，以及 Facebook 当时删除这些帖子以及封禁总统账号的做法是否正当。

sentences.en: And those members, those five members went through
sentences.zh: 这些成员，这五名成员查阅了

sentences.en: 9,000 comments that were submitted from the public.
sentences.zh: 从公众那里提交的 9000 条评论。

sentences.en: There were public comments submitted that reflect anger that the company took down the site as well as warnings that the company should not let Trump back on.
sentences.zh: 提交的公众评论既反映了对公司删除该网站的愤怒，也有警告称公司不应让特朗普重返。

sentences.en: One commenter said power corrupts and absolute power corrupts absolutely.
sentences.zh: 一位评论者说，权力导致腐败，绝对权力导致绝对腐败。

sentences.en: If you permanently block Trump for just being Trump, you've gone even further down the power corrupts rabbit hole with other mega rich oligarchs who are exercising their
sentences.zh: 如果你仅仅因为特朗普是特朗普而永久封禁他，你就在“权力导致腐败”的兔子洞里走得更远了，与其他那些正在行使

sentences.en: power muscles to show us who really runs America.
sentences.zh: 权力肌肉来向我们展示谁才是美国真正统治者的超级富豪寡头同流合污。

sentences.en: On the other side, however, people were very strongly in favor of keeping Trump's account down.
sentences.zh: 然而，另一方面，人们非常强烈地支持维持对特朗普账号的封禁。

sentences.en: One commenter said, Donald Trump is a toxic garbage person who peddles lies and conspiracy theories and hate.
sentences.zh: 一位评论者说，唐纳德·特朗普是一个散布谎言、阴谋论和仇恨的有毒垃圾人。

sentences.en: Facebook was right to ban him.
sentences.zh: Facebook 封禁他是对的。

sentences.en: So this board weighted through 9,000 of those comments.
sentences.zh: 所以这个委员会筛选了其中 9000 条评论。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So when do you get word that there's actually a ruling?
sentences.zh: 那么，你们什么时候会收到消息说实际上有了裁决？

sentences.en: I'm guessing this might or might not at all resemble what it's like when the Supreme Court alerts journalists that a decision is coming.
sentences.zh: 我猜这可能完全类似于、也可能完全不类似于最高法院提醒记者有裁决即将出台的情形。

sentences.en: You know, actually, it felt a lot like that, Michael.
sentences.zh: 你知道，实际上，感觉非常相似，迈克尔。

sentences.en: In fact, the board gave 48 hours to the media to prepare for the announcement of their decision.
sentences.zh: 事实上，委员会给了媒体 48 小时的时间来为他们决定公布做准备。

sentences.en: They made their decision days before, and they actually had told Facebook about their decision.
sentences.zh: 他们在几天前就做出了决定，并且实际上已经将他们的决定告诉了 Facebook。

sentences.en: But this was all kept under lock and key.
sentences.zh: 但这一切都保密得严严实实。

sentences.en: And unlike most news related to Facebook, there were no leaks on this.
sentences.zh: 与大多数与 Facebook 相关的新闻不同，这件事没有泄露。

sentences.en: So on Wednesday morning, I woke up really going into the announcement blind.
sentences.zh: 所以在周三早上，我醒来时确实对即将公布的消息一无所知。

sentences.en: And at 9 a.m., I opened up my email, and there is the decision and a note that the board is going to get on the phone and explain their ruling.
sentences.zh: 上午 9 点，我打开电子邮件，里面有裁决结果，还有一条便条，称委员会将通过电话解释他们的裁决。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·荣森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其周围文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night, you took 300 of your most
sentences.zh: 甚至早在黑胶唱片时代的夜总会里当 DJ 时，你每晚都要带上 300 张你最

sentences.en: prized possessions to work with you, and you turned a DJ booth into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 珍视的藏品去工作，你把一个 DJ 台变成了这样一个充满活力的、展示 50 年前精美老物件的快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听来自爱彼的《重构者》。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你可以免费探索《时报》一个月，而无需输入信用卡，会怎么样呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在该应用程序中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能得到什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是《纽约时报》的订户，请立即下载《时报》应用程序并获得 30 天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Welcome to the webinar.
sentences.zh: 欢迎参加网络研讨会。

sentences.en: Please stand by.
sentences.zh: 请稍候。

sentences.en: The webinar will begin shortly.
sentences.zh: 网络研讨会将很快开始。

sentences.en: Please remain on the line.
sentences.zh: 请保持在线。

sentences.en: So, Cecilia, tell us about this call.
sentences.zh: 那么，塞西莉亚，给我们讲讲这个电话吧。

sentences.en: The broadcast is now starting.
sentences.zh: 广播现在开始。

sentences.en: All attendees are in listen-only mode.
sentences.zh: 所有与会者均处于仅听模式。

sentences.en: So, we get on the phone and members of the board are there and they launch right into it.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们拨通了电话，董事会成员都在那里，他们直接切入了正题。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Our decision this morning is relevant.
sentences.zh: 我们今天早上的决定很重要。

sentences.en: And we hear from one of the co-chairs, Michael McConnell, who is a constitutional law professor at Stanford Law School.
sentences.zh: 我们听取了其中一位联合主席迈克尔·麦康奈尔的意见，他是斯坦福大学法学院的宪法学教授。

sentences.en: First, for violation of the policy against praising or encouraging violent actors.
sentences.zh: 首先，因为违反了禁止赞美或鼓励暴力行者的政策。

sentences.en: He said, first, Facebook had sufficient justification to remove his posts on January 6th.
sentences.zh: 他说，首先，Facebook有充分的理由删除他在1月6日的帖子。

sentences.en: Second, we agree that Facebook had sufficient justification to suspend Mr. Trump's account, at least for the duration of what the Department of Homeland Security called a, quote,
sentences.zh: 其次，我们同意Facebook有充分的理由暂停特朗普先生的账号，至少在国土安全部所谓的、引述的

sentences.en: heightened risk of violence.
sentences.zh: 暴力风险加剧期间。

sentences.en: However, McConnell then said, But we hold that it was improper, that is to say, in violation of Facebook's own rules,
sentences.zh: 然而，麦康奈尔随后表示，但我们认为这是不当的，也就是说，违反了Facebook自身的规则，

sentences.en: as well as generally accepted principles of freedom of expression, for Facebook to make that suspension indefinite.
sentences.zh: 以及普遍接受的言论自由原则，Facebook将这种暂停设为无限期是不对的。

sentences.en: He said, Facebook's own policies do not authorize an indefinite suspension.
sentences.zh: 他说，Facebook自身的政策并不授权无限期暂停。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: But users and their audiences must not be left in a state of uncertainty as to time or reasons for restoration.
sentences.zh: 但不能让用户及其受众对恢复的时间或原因处于不确定状态。

sentences.en: So they're saying, in essence, Facebook, you were right to ban the president and to take down those posts on January 7th, because there was an imminent threat of harm.
sentences.zh: 所以他们本质上是在说，Facebook，你在1月7日封禁总统并删除那些帖子是正确的，因为当时存在迫在眉睫的伤害威胁。

sentences.en: Things were really heated during that time.
sentences.zh: 那段时间局势确实非常紧张。

sentences.en: And the president was violating your own rules.
sentences.zh: 而且总统违反了你们自己的规则。

sentences.en: But they said, Facebook, you were wrong in imposing an indefinite ban without any criteria or any guidelines on when or if there could be an end to this indefinite ban.
sentences.zh: 但他们说，Facebook，你们实施无限期封禁是错误的，没有任何标准或指导方针说明这种无限期封禁何时或是否会有终点。

sentences.en: Facebook must make its decision and be held accountable for whatever it decides.
sentences.zh: Facebook必须做出决定，并为其做出的任何决定承担责任。

sentences.en: Ultimately, it is the public that will be the judge.
sentences.zh: 最终，公众将是法官。

sentences.en: That is as it should be in a democratic society.
sentences.zh: 在民主社会中本该如此。

sentences.en: So what Facebook's equivalent of the Supreme Court has said here is that an indefinite ban of the former president violates Facebook's own rules
sentences.zh: 所以Facebook相当于最高法院的机构在这里表示，对前总统的无限期封禁违反了Facebook自身的规则

sentences.en: and the kind of corporate spirit of Facebook as a social media platform.
sentences.zh: 以及Facebook作为社交媒体平台的企业精神。

sentences.en: And so what does the board then say Facebook is supposed to do with this objection to an indefinite ban?
sentences.zh: 那么董事会随后表示，对于反对无限期封禁这一异议，Facebook应该怎么做？

sentences.en: So the board effectively kicks the decision back to Facebook.
sentences.zh: 所以董事会实际上把这个决定踢回给了Facebook。

sentences.en: The board says, you have six months to decide on your own whether you want to ban Trump permanently or not.
sentences.zh: 董事会表示，你们有六个月的时间自行决定是否要永久封禁特朗普。

sentences.en: We shouldn't do this.
sentences.zh: 我们不该这样做。

sentences.en: And one thing that really stuck out to me, Michael, is they said, in applying a vague standardless penalty and then referring this case to the board to resolve,
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，有一件事真正让我印象深刻，那就是他们说，在应用了模糊的、没有标准的惩罚然后将此案提交给董事会解决后，

sentences.en: Facebook seeks to avoid its responsibilities.
sentences.zh: Facebook试图逃避其责任。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So Facebook sends a decision to the Oversight Board on January 21St.
sentences.zh: 所以Facebook在1月21日将决定送交监督委员会。

sentences.en: The Oversight Board on May 5th sends it back to Facebook effectively.
sentences.zh: 监督委员会在5月5日实际上把它退回给了Facebook。

sentences.en: I suddenly feel like I'm talking to our colleague Adam Liptak about the Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 我突然觉得自己好像在和我们的同事亚当·利普塔克谈论最高法院。

sentences.en: The Supreme Court was given a case from the Ninth Circuit.
sentences.zh: 最高法院审理了一个来自第九巡回法院的案件。

sentences.en: It didn't like the decision, so it kicked it back to the Ninth Circuit.
sentences.zh: 它不喜欢这个判决，所以把它踢回给了第九巡回法院。

sentences.en: But that's effectively what happened here, which is that Facebook's Supreme Court is kicking a case back down to a lower court,
sentences.zh: 但这实际上就是这里发生的事情，也就是Facebook的最高法院将案件踢回给下级法院，

sentences.en: in this case to Facebook itself, and saying, you didn't do this correctly, and it's your problem to figure out how to do it correctly.
sentences.zh: 在本案中是Facebook本身，并说，你们没有正确处理这件事，如何正确处理是你们自己的问题。

sentences.en: Yes, and this may take a lot longer for a final decision as it weaves through these different decision-making processes.
sentences.zh: 是的，随着在这些不同的决策过程中曲折前进，最终决定可能需要更长的时间。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: I want to linger for just a minute on the board's thinking about why a permanent ban is inappropriate.
sentences.zh: 我想花一分钟时间探讨一下董事会关于为什么永久封禁是不合适的的想法。

sentences.en: It sounds like it's basing it, to keep going down this Supreme Court metaphor, on the kind of Facebook constitution, on Facebook's own rules.
sentences.zh: 听起来它是基于——延续这个最高法院的比喻——类似于Facebook宪法的东西，即Facebook自己的规则。

sentences.en: But I think on a practical level, there are plenty of people who would look at what former President Trump did on January 6th and say that's the ultimate reason
sentences.zh: 但我认为在实际层面上，有很多人看到前总统特朗普在1月6日的所作所为后会认为那是终极理由

sentences.en: to permanently ban someone from a social media platform.
sentences.zh: 将某人永久封禁出社交媒体平台。

sentences.en: They helped incite a riot at the United States Capitol.
sentences.zh: 他们煽动了美国国会大厦的骚乱。

sentences.en: Yeah, I was really struck by how the board's decision and their reasoning on a permanent ban was sort of procedural in the same way that you see that a lot with court rulings,
sentences.zh: 是的，我真的很震惊，董事会的决定以及他们关于永久封禁的推理在某种程序上是非常程序化的，就像你在很多法庭裁决中经常看到的那样，

sentences.en: like real court rulings in real life, where they really wanted to adhere to the letter of the law, and the law in this case being Facebook's own laws.
sentences.zh: 就像现实生活中的真正法庭裁决一样，他们非常希望遵守法律的字面规定，而本案中的法律就是Facebook自己的法律。

sentences.en: So it's this weird sort of parallel world, Michael, where a private company forms a oversight board, this third party that is trying to adjudicate these speech decisions
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个奇怪的平行世界，迈克尔，一家私营公司成立了一个监督委员会，这个第三方正试图根据私营公司制定的法律

sentences.en: according to laws created by a private company.
sentences.zh: 来裁决这些言论决定。

sentences.en: It's all very similar, and the parallels are striking to what court systems are like within the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这一切都非常相似，其与美国境内和世界各地法院系统的平行关系令人震惊。

sentences.en: and around the world.
sentences.zh: 世界各地。

sentences.en: So because this ruling seems to be based on technical language from the company, rather than a giant principle of free speech, what implications does this ruling have?
sentences.zh: 因此，由于这项裁决似乎是基于公司的技术性语言，而不是言论自由的宏大原则，这项裁决会产生什么影响？

sentences.en: Does it have any implications for free speech by government leaders like a Donald Trump?
sentences.zh: 它对唐纳德·特朗普等政府领导人的言论自由有什么影响吗？

sentences.en: I think world leaders were hoping for clear guidance on what would kick them off of a site like Facebook.
sentences.zh: 我认为世界领导人一直希望得到明确的指导，知道什么行为会让他们被踢出像Facebook这样的网站。

sentences.en: They wanted the oversight board's decision to clarify what has for a long time been a lot of ad hoc decision-making when it came to politicians
sentences.zh: 他们希望监督委员会的决定能够澄清长期以来在政治家问题上存在的许多临时决策，

sentences.en: and what politicians say on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 以及政治家在Facebook上所说的话。

sentences.en: But they didn't get that.
sentences.zh: 但他们没有得到这个。

sentences.en: And in fact, what they got was the board sending the decision back to Facebook, which some world leaders have said is the problem to begin with.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他们得到的是董事会将决定退回给Facebook，一些世界领导人认为这正是问题的根源所在。

sentences.en: Angela Merkel of Germany had said, after Facebook's ban of Trump on January 7th, that this points to really the power of a few big internet platforms over speech entirely.
sentences.zh: 德国的安格拉·默克尔在Facebook于1月7日封禁特朗普后曾表示，这确实指出了少数几家大型互联网平台对言论本身的权力。

sentences.en: And it shows that these companies have too much power.
sentences.zh: 这表明这些公司拥有太多的权力。

sentences.en: And so by sending this decision back to Facebook, it again puts the power-making and the decision-making in the hands of the company that many political leaders feel
sentences.zh: 因此，通过将这个决定退回给Facebook，它再次将权力制造和决策权交到了许多政治领导人认为

sentences.en: are too powerful as gatekeepers of speech to begin with.
sentences.zh: 本来就作为言论把关人而权力过大的公司手中。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So a person like Angela Merkel would have been reassured to know that a quasi-independent board was going to be making a decision like this,
sentences.zh: 所以像安格拉·默克尔这样的人如果知道一个准独立委员会将做出这样的决定，会感到放心，

sentences.en: saying, this is what will get you kicked off Facebook.
sentences.zh: 会觉得：这就是让你被踢出Facebook的原因。

sentences.en: But when the board decided not to really make that decision and to send it back to the company, it was reinforcing the idea that these enormously consequential decisions
sentences.zh: 但当董事会决定不真正做出那个决定而是把它退回给公司时，它巩固了这样一个理念：这些极其重大的决定——

sentences.en: about what can or can't be and who can or can't be on a platform like Facebook are ultimately going to be made by one or two people like Mark Zuckerberg.
sentences.zh: 关于什么能或不能在像Facebook这样的平台上出现、谁能或不能留在平台上——最终还是要由一两个人（如马克·扎克伯格）来做决定。

sentences.en: That's right, Michael.
sentences.zh: 没错，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Well, essentially, Facebook is back to the drawing board and making its own decisions on Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 嗯，基本上，Facebook又回到了原点，重新自己对唐纳德·特朗普做出决定。

sentences.en: Instead of the Supreme Court of Facebook, which was the whole idea of creating a Supreme Court of Facebook.
sentences.zh: 而不是Facebook最高法院，而这正是创建Facebook最高法院的全部意义所在。

sentences.en: Yes, that's right.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: So do you think Mark Zuckerberg even likes this decision?
sentences.zh: 那你觉得马克·扎克伯格甚至会喜欢这个决定吗？

sentences.en: I mean, if I'm the leader of Facebook, I would very much, I think, have hoped that this outside board would make this decision for me.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果我是Facebook的领导者，我想我非常希望这个外部委员会能替我做出这个决定。

sentences.en: That's what he said all along, that he doesn't believe that he or Facebook should be making such consequential decisions.
sentences.zh: 他一直都是这么说的，他认为他和Facebook都不应该做出如此重大的决定。

sentences.en: But ultimately, Facebook will still be confronted with the decision on what to do with Trump, which has been a problem for the company throughout the former president's tenure
sentences.zh: 但归根结底，Facebook仍将面对如何处理特朗普的决定，在前总统任职期间，这一直是该公司的一个问题，

sentences.en: and continues to do so, even with the president out of office.
sentences.zh: 而且即使总统已经卸任，这种情况仍在继续。

sentences.en: And what was former President Trump's response to this decision?
sentences.zh: 前总统特朗普对这个决定有什么回应？

sentences.en: Do we know?
sentences.zh: 我们知道吗？

sentences.en: About two hours after the Oversight Board's decision,
sentences.zh: 在大约监督委员会做出决定两小时后，

sentences.en: Trump issued a statement, and that statement landed in my inbox of my email.
sentences.zh: 特朗普发表了一份声明，那份声明落入了我的电子邮箱收件箱里。

sentences.en: And in that statement, he said a lot of the predictable and usual things he says about social media, which is that it's run by radical leftists
sentences.zh: 在那份声明中，他说了许多关于社交媒体的可以预见的和通常的话，即它是被激进左翼分子掌控的，

sentences.en: and that these companies are too powerful.
sentences.zh: 并且这些公司权力太大。

sentences.en: And he continues to deny the election results and the process.
sentences.zh: 他继续否认选举结果和选举过程。

sentences.en: And as I was reading Trump's statement and the board's decision, I was thinking that the board was essentially saying, I think that there should at least be the possibility
sentences.zh: 正当我阅读特朗普的声明和董事会的决定时，我在想，董事会基本上是在说，我认为至少应该存在这种可能性：

sentences.en: that Trump comes back onto the platform.
sentences.zh: 特朗普重返该平台。

sentences.en: The question, however, is how and under what circumstances?
sentences.zh: 然而问题是，以什么方式以及在什么情况下？

sentences.en: Because as we can see,
sentences.zh: 因为正如我们所见，

sentences.en: Trump is still doing all the things that got him banned from social media, just on different platforms this time.
sentences.zh: 特朗普仍在做所有导致他被社交媒体封禁的事情，只是这次换成了不同的平台。

sentences.en: So Facebook will be faced again with these same kinds of questions and will need to solve those questions for itself.
sentences.zh: 因此，Facebook将再次面临这些同样类型的问题，并且需要自己解决这些问题。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Not this board.
sentences.zh: 而不是这个董事会。

sentences.en: Indeed.
sentences.zh: 的确如此。

sentences.en: Thank you, Cecilia.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，塞西莉亚。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thanks so much for having me.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢邀请我参加。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, the Biden administration said that it favored waiving patent protections for COVID-19 vaccines, a potential breakthrough in the global effort
sentences.zh: 周三，拜登政府表示赞成放弃对新冠疫苗的专利保护，这是全球努力中的一个潜在突破，

sentences.en: to speed up vaccinations.
sentences.zh: 旨在加速疫苗接种。

sentences.en: Suspending patent rights would allow companies in smaller countries to cheaply manufacture the vaccines by using the recipes developed by companies like Pfizer, Moderna,
sentences.zh: 暂停专利权将允许较小国家中的公司利用辉瑞、莫德纳

sentences.en: and Johnson & Johnson.
sentences.zh: 和强生等公司开发的配方，廉价生产疫苗。

sentences.en: But the move is opposed by the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但此举遭到美国制药行业的反对，

sentences.en: pharmaceutical industry, which argues that giving away patent rights destroys the incentive for companies like Pfizer to invest in life-saving vaccines in the future.
sentences.zh: 该行业认为，放弃专利权破坏了辉瑞等公司未来投资拯救生命的疫苗的动力。

sentences.en: And the fate of the No.
